title: Equality of average cost definitions
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\alpha$ be finite sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates with leaves labelled in $\alpha$. The auxiliary average cost of $T$ under the product distribution with coordinate law $\pi$ equals its deterministic average cost under that same distribution.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$T$ is a finite alphabet decision tree on $n$ coordinates
